suppress.notes: False positive. CVE-2026-40984 is a DoS in Micrometer's HTTP server instrumentations. Per the Spring advisory (https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-40984/) the affected branches are 1.9.0-1.9.17, 1.13.0-1.13.18, 1.14.0-1.14.15, 1.15.0-1.15.11 and 1.16.0-1.16.5 — the 1.10.x-1.12.x line is NOT affected. micrometer-core 1.10.1 is pulled transitively by http4k-ops-micrometer; NVD's CPE range over-matches and flags it anyway. This suppression is scoped to 1.10.x-1.12.x only, so a future bump into a genuinely affected branch is still reported.
